regulars.name: Mrs Pike
regulars.bio: Keeps a tank of red guppies on her piano, and talks to them while she practises.

regulars.name: Mr Okafor
regulars.greeting: Afternoon! Got any blues? They remind me of the sea.
regulars.bio: Retired ferry captain. Says a blue guppy is the next best thing to the open water.

regulars.name: Little Ines
regulars.greeting: Hi! I saved my pocket money. Do you have a yellow one?
regulars.bio: Nine years old and very serious about fish. Visits every Saturday with her dad.

regulars.name: Professor Bell
regulars.greeting: Ah, splendid. Is there a turquoise one worth studying?
regulars.bio: Teaches genetics at the university and keeps careful notes on every guppy she buys.

regulars.name: Granny Rosa
regulars.greeting: Hello, dear. Something orange, like my marmalade?
regulars.bio: Brings jam for the shop every spring. Her orange guppies are named after her grandchildren.

regulars.name: Dev
regulars.greeting: Hey! Any spotty ones in? Dalmatians are my favourite.
regulars.bio: Art student who sketches the fish between lectures. Pays with coins from a jar.

regulars.name: Auntie Mei
regulars.greeting: There you are! Do you have a koi guppy for my pond tank?
regulars.bio: Runs the noodle shop down the road and keeps a koi guppy by the till for luck.

regulars.name: Mr Lindqvist
regulars.greeting: Good day. I'm after something gold, if the shop can oblige.
regulars.bio: A retired clockmaker who says a gold guppy keeps better time than any watch.
